title: Camera events, driver by driver
blurb: Netradyne camera events land in Warrior Ops by themselves — pinned to the van and driver, with a hotspot map and a snapshot to send the driver.

title: Photograph the van before it goes out
blurb: Hire vans are now walked round and photographed before they go on the road, and again the day they go back — the same angles, so an invoice months later has an answer.

title: Drivers can work two sites
blurb: Two sites can share some of their drivers, in both directions, without anyone being moved between them.

title: Lend a driver, keep the pay straight
blurb: Send a driver to help another station for a few shifts — one record, their own G-Number, both pay sheets right.

title: Van checks fill themselves in
blurb: The ClearQuote tracker now updates itself every hour — nobody presses anything for the morning's checks to appear.
